verdicts.reason: A: the logo is shrunk to a tiny top-right mark that loses its centred prominence, and the sticker is crammed into the bottom-right corner, where it is clipped and butts against the legal line. Otherwise the headline wraps cleanly on two lines and the CTA has room to breathe. B has the same tiny logo and the same clipped sticker colliding with the legal text. On top of that, its headline is blown up to three lines and crowds the CTA, the near full-width CTA sits jammed against the legal text, and the NEW badge is oversized, so the bottom half feels cramped and top-heavy.
